Chichicastenango market is located in Guatemala's highlands. Meeting local women offers insight into the agricultural side of everyday life.

On the Discover Guatemala tour, the excursion takes place on Sunday before the journey to Lake Atitlán. Both the market visit and the workshop are included in the day's itinerary. The exact hands-on activities depend on how the meeting is arranged; this experience does not promise a cooking session.

You will visit Chichicastenango's traditional Indigenous market. Textiles, handicrafts and everyday goods are sold here, and exploring the market is part of the experience.

Local women then lead a workshop on preparing dishes made from corn, introducing you to one of the staples of Guatemalan cuisine. On the Guatemala–Belize itinerary, the journey continues to Lake Atitlán after the workshop.

In the Cordillera de la Sal, rocky formations and dry valleys create a landscape reminiscent of the Moon's surface. The route crosses Los Flamencos National Reserve and introduces the desert scenery around San Pedro de Atacama. Views of the Andes and the changing light add to the experience. If your journey continues by plane, sightseeing is scheduled around your flight; sunset is included only if the timetable permits.
